name: Copywriting
tagline: Draft headlines, ads, and landing-page copy using your brand guidelines.

useCases.title: Ad variation sets
useCases.description: Generate a batch of ad headlines and primary text in different angles from one product brief, ready for A/B testing.

useCases.title: Landing page copy
useCases.description: Draft a landing page's headline, benefits, and call to action from your offer and voice.

useCases.title: Email subject lines
useCases.description: Write subject lines and preview text for a campaign, each with a different hook.

useCases.title: Product and feature naming
useCases.description: Brainstorm name and tagline candidates for a product or feature that fit your brand, with a short rationale for each.

useCases.title: Tone and length rewrites
useCases.description: Take an approved line and produce shorter, bolder, or more formal versions to fit a specific channel or character limit.

useCases.title: Campaign copy in one workflow
useCases.description: One workflow drafts the ad, email, and landing copy, then saves it to your marketing tool.

faq.q: Will the copy stay on brand?
faq.a: Yes. Add your voice guidelines and product facts to a Space, and Ryu drafts every variation from them, so the tone is consistent and the offer is stated correctly.

faq.q: Can I keep an unannounced campaign private?
faq.a: Yes. Use a local model and drafts stay on your machine; check which connected tools see the work. Analytics and crash reports are on by default and can be turned off.
No. Ryu drafts many variations quickly; a copywriter picks, edits, and approves what ships.
